mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.8% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE rises above 3.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals a monetary policy response to labor market weakness, which typically precedes economic slowdown and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market weakness
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts, the market anticipates economic peak and policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the prior month indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.1% from prior month.
